acceptanceCriteria: A decision records whether a TTL-only policy change is handoff-compatible.

If yes: HandoffPolicy.Compatible accepts a diff limited to holderLiveness, and a maintained test shows a live evidence HANDOFF stays valid across a TTL-only policy update while any other policy change still fences it.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Raised by the V1-0625 lane (2026-10-06, CAL-V0-120..121). Any policy change, including the new optional holderLiveness.heartbeatTTLSeconds key, marks live evidence handoffs STALE_POLICY, because the key is not in the journal audit's handoff policy-compatible diff set (HandoffPolicy.Compatible). The TTL only drives derived, read-time holder status and never writes or fences, so treating a TTL-only change as compatible looks safe. The lane left it alone because it is in the V1-0645 audit area.
